about.title: About CampusLoop
about.description: CampusLoop is a free academic companion platform built for Indian engineering and college students: syllabus study guides, question banks, practical coding labs, and attendance tools.
about.body:
CampusLoop started as a shared folder of notes between classmates at ITM (SLS) Baroda University. Before every exam the same problem returned: study material existed, but it was scattered across WhatsApp groups, unformatted PDFs hard to read on a mobile screen, and blurry slide photos.

**CampusLoop puts your entire semester in one calm, beautifully structured place.** Every study guide, lecture note, slide deck and handwritten page is transcribed into clean, high-contrast, distraction-free reading with your exact place saved across devices.

## Our Core Commitments

- **Studying is 100% Free**: All core curriculum study guides, notes, coding practicals, and question banks are accessible without paywalls.
- **Zero Dark Patterns**: We strictly comply with the CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Dark Patterns 2023. No hidden fees, no drip pricing, no false urgency, and no forced recurring subscriptions.
- **Your Data Stays Yours**: We strictly comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. We do not sell your personal data or profile details to third-party advertisers.
- **Transparent Numbers**: Every count, question set, and progress metric is computed directly from genuine curriculum data.

## Platform Features

- **Library**: Comprehensive zero-to-hero study guides covering each syllabus unit from scratch, plus lecture decks and question papers.
- **Exam Practice**: Solved previous year university questions, mid-semester test formats, and chapter quizzes.
- **Interactive Coding Lab**: Practical code harness with real compiler feedback, expected outputs, and viva preparation questions.
- **Attendance & SGPA Calculator**: Helps students maintain the statutory 75% attendance criteria and project target semester SGPA.
- **Campus Community**: Verified student network to form study groups, discuss assignments, and share insights.

## Creator & Institutional Disclaimer

CampusLoop is developed and maintained independently by **Maher Bhatt** with **Velocity Web**. CampusLoop is an independent educational platform and is not an administrative affiliate of any university. Institutional administrative services, official grade sheets, and university fee collections are maintained at their respective official portals.

If you are an academic author or educator with questions, corrections, or attribution updates, please reach out via our [contact page](/contact) or email **support@campusloop.in**.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, IT Act 2000 Section 43A, and SPDI Rules 2011.
privacy.body:
*Effective Date: 14 November 2026 | Last Updated: 14 November 2026*

This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, storage, and protection of personal data on **CampusLoop** ("we", "our", or "the Platform"), accessible via web (`itm-notes-new.vercel.app` and associated domains) and mobile applications. CampusLoop is operated by **Maher Bhatt** in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.

We are committed to upholding the highest standards of data privacy and transparency in strict compliance with the **Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)**, the **Information Technology Act, 2000 (IT Act)**, the **Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 (SPDI Rules)**, and the **Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021**.

---

## 1. Notice under Section 5 of the DPDP Act, 2023

As a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act, we provide itemized notice of the personal data processed, the explicit purpose of processing, and the mechanisms through which you may exercise your legal rights.

### A. Data You Provide Directly
| Category | Specific Data Points | Purpose of Processing | Legal Basis |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Identity & Authentication** | Email address, Password (cryptographically hashed), Google OAuth Display Name, Google Profile Picture | To authenticate your account, prevent unauthorized access, and create your student profile | Consent (Section 6, DPDP Act) |
| **Academic Profile** | University name, Degree program (B.Tech, BCA, etc.), Branch/Discipline, Semester, Section/Division, Enrollment Number (optional) | To deliver your syllabus-specific curriculum, class timetables, and personalized exam materials | Consent & Educational Customization |
| **Study Activity & Progress** | Reading progress, saved bookmarks, quiz scores, coding lab submissions, attendance logs, daily study streaks | To track learning progress, maintain gamified XP/levels, and save your reading place | User Request & Performance of Service |
| **Community Interactions** | Posts, comments, likes, friend requests, study group messages | To operate the interactive student community feed | User Consent |
| **Communications** | Messages submitted through our Contact form or support tickets | To respond to student inquiries and handle grievance reports | Legitimate Service Delivery |

### B. Data Collected Automatically
- **Device & Technical Telemetry**: Browser type, operating system version, screen resolution, and anonymized error logs. This data is used solely to troubleshoot application crashes and optimize mobile responsiveness.
- **Local Storage Cache**: We store non-tracking state variables in your browser's `localStorage` (such as dark/light theme preference, offline notes cache, and authentication session tokens). See our [Cookie & Storage Policy](/cookies) for full itemization.

### C. Data We NEVER Collect
- We do **not** collect sensitive financial payment credentials, bank account passwords, or Aadhaar numbers.
- We do **not** access your device contacts, SMS, microphone, or camera without affirmative, task-specific permission.
- We do **not** engage in cross-site tracking, behavioral ad targeting, or sale of personal data.

---

## 2. Age Consent & Protection of Children (Section 9, DPDP Act)

CampusLoop is designed for higher education and university students. As mandated under Section 9 of the DPDP Act 2023:
- Users must be at least **18 years of age**, or have obtained verifiable consent from their parent or lawful legal guardian prior to registering an account.
- We do **not** undertake tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at individuals under 18 years of age.
- If we become aware that personal data of a minor has been collected without verifiable parental consent, we will take immediate steps to delete such data from our servers.

---

## 3. Purpose Limitation & Data Minimization

In accordance with the principles of data minimization and purpose limitation under the DPDP Act 2023:
1. Your personal data is collected exclusively for specified, explicit, and legitimate educational purposes.
2. We collect only the minimum amount of personal data necessary to operate the platform features you actively use.
3. Your data is retained only for as long as your account remains active or as required to fulfill legal and academic record obligations.

---

## 4. Rights of Data Principals (Your Legal Rights)

Under Chapter III of the DPDP Act 2023, you hold the following statutory rights regarding your personal data:

1. **Right to Access Information (Section 11)**: You have the right to obtain a summary of your personal data being processed and the identities of any Data Processors with whom it has been shared.
2. **Right to Correction & Updating (Section 12)**: You can edit and update your display name, profile photo, university, semester, and branch at any time from your [Profile Settings](/profile).
3. **Right to Erasure / Right to be Forgotten (Section 12)**: You have the right to request the total erasure of your personal data. You may trigger an automated deletion request through your profile settings or by visiting our [Data Deletion Page](/data-deletion). Data is erased from live production databases within 30 calendar days.
4. **Right of Grievance Redressal (Section 13)**: You have the right to have your grievances addressed by our designated Grievance Officer.
5. **Right to Nominate (Section 14)**: You have the right to nominate an individual who will exercise your data rights in the event of death or incapacity.

---

## 5. Security Safeguards (Section 43A, IT Act 2000)

We implement reasonable security practices and procedures as required under Section 43A of the IT Act 2000 and the SPDI Rules 2011:
- **Encryption in Transit**: All data transmission across CampusLoop is enforced via Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3 / HTTPS).
- **Database Security**: Our database layer (powered by Supabase with AWS/GCP infrastructure) employs AES-256 encryption at rest.
- **Row-Level Security (RLS)**: Fine-grained database access policies ensure students can only view or modify their own private records.
- **Password Protection**: Passwords are never stored in plaintext; they are irreversibly hashed using standard cryptographic algorithms (bcrypt/argon2).

---

## 6. Third-Party Service Providers (Data Processors)

We engage trusted, reputable infrastructure providers to deliver our services:
- **Supabase Inc.**: Cloud database, user authentication, and secure file storage.
- **Vercel Inc.**: Edge network hosting and frontend application delivery.
- **Google Cloud Platform**: OAuth 2.0 authentication for one-click Google Sign-In.
- **Google Fonts**: Delivery of open-source typography (IP address is received by Google during font file download).

We do **not** sell, rent, or trade your personal information with data brokers or marketing firms.

---

## 7. Statutory Grievance Redressal Mechanism

In compliance with **Rule 5(9) of the Information Technology (SPDI) Rules, 2011**, **Rule 3(2) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules, 2021**, and **Section 13 of the DPDP Act, 2023**, the details of our designated Grievance Officer are published below:

- **Grievance Officer**: Maher Bhatt
- **Designation**: Founder & Chief Compliance Officer, CampusLoop
- **Physical Address**: CampusLoop, Near ITM SLS Baroda University Campus, Paldi, Vadodara, Gujarat - 391510, India
- **Official Grievance Email**: [grievance@campusloop.in](mailto:grievance@campusloop.in)
- **Support Email**: [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in)
- **Support Contact / WhatsApp**: [+91 94294 86337](https://wa.me/919429486337)

### Grievance Timelines
- **Acknowledgment**: Your complaint will be acknowledged within **48 hours** of receipt.
- **Disposal / Resolution**: Your grievance will be investigated and resolved within **30 calendar days** from the date of receipt.
- **Escalation to Data Protection Board**: If you are not satisfied with the resolution provided by our Grievance Officer, you may escalate your complaint to the **Data Protection Board of India** as provided under the DPDP Act 2023.

---

## 8. Updates to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements or platform features. Significant modifications will be announced via an in-app notice or email banner. The "Last Updated" date at the top of this document indicates the effective revision date.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Terms of Service governing the use of CampusLoop under the Indian Contract Act 1872 and the Information Technology Act 2000.
terms.body:
*Effective Date: 14 November 2026 | Last Updated: 14 November 2026*

Welcome to **CampusLoop** ("the Service", "the Platform", "we", or "us"). By accessing or using CampusLoop via web or mobile devices, you ("User", "Student", or "you") agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). These Terms constitute a legally binding electronic agreement between you and CampusLoop under the **Indian Contract Act, 1872** and the **Information Technology Act, 2000**.

If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Platform.

---

## 1. Eligibility & Capacity to Contract

Under Section 11 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, you must be legally competent to contract. By using CampusLoop, you represent and warrant that:
1. You are at least **18 years of age**, or are accessing the platform with the verified permission and supervision of a parent or legal guardian.
2. You are an enrolled college or university student, educator, or lifelong learner.
3. You have not been previously suspended or barred from the Platform for policy violations.

---

## 2. Description of Service & Pricing

CampusLoop provides an independent academic study portal featuring:
- Course syllabus summaries, unit-by-unit study guides, and transcribed previous-year question papers.
- Practical coding laboratory exercises with sample outputs and viva preparation guides.
- Attendance tracker (75% threshold monitoring) and semester SGPA calculators.
- Student discussion forums, study groups, and community messaging.

### 100% Free Core Academic Access
All core curriculum reading materials, notes, question papers, and interactive tools are provided **completely free of charge**. CampusLoop adheres strictly to the **Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020** and the **CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Dark Patterns, 2023**:
- **No Hidden Fees**: We do not charge hidden subscription fees, platform surcharges, or maintenance deductions.
- **No Forced Subscriptions**: There are no bait-and-switch models or subscription traps.

---

## 3. User Accounts & Responsibilities

1. **Accurate Registration**: You agree to provide true, accurate, and current information during registration (including Google OAuth sign-in) and onboarding.
2. **Account Security**: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials. You must notify us immediately at **support@campusloop.in** if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
3. **Single User License**: Your account is personal to you and may not be shared, rented, or transferred to third parties.

---

## 4. Acceptable Use & Intermediary Compliance (IT Rules 2021)

As an intermediary under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act 2000 and Rule 3(1)(b) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, we require that you **do not host, display, upload, modify, publish, transmit, or share** any content that:
- Belongs to another person and to which you do not have a lawful right;
- Is grossly harmful, harassing, blasphemous, defamatory, obscene, pornographic, pedophilic, libelous, or racially or ethnically objectionable;
- Deceives or misleads the addressee about the origin of the message or communicates any misinformation;
- Impersonates another person or student;
- Threatens the unity, integrity, defense, security, or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with foreign states, or public order;
- Contains software viruses, trojans, worms, or any code designed to interrupt, destroy, or limit the functionality of any computer resource;
- Promotes academic dishonesty, such as soliciting or sharing live examination papers during an ongoing university test or attempting to alter official grading servers.

Any account found engaging in prohibited behavior may be suspended or permanently terminated without prior notice.

---

## 5. Intellectual Property & Fair Use Educational Attribution

1. **Platform Proprietary Rights**: The CampusLoop user interface, brand assets, logos, code architecture, and database schemas are the intellectual property of CampusLoop and Maher Bhatt.
2. **Curriculum Material & Fair Use**: University course syllabi, lecture notes, textbook summaries, and previous-year question papers hosted on CampusLoop are curated for educational review, scholarship, and student reference under the **Fair Dealing / Fair Use doctrine recognized under Section 52(1)(a) & (h) of the Indian Copyright Act, 1957**.
3. **Takedown Requests (Notice & Takedown)**: We respect the intellectual property rights of academic authors, universities, and publishers. If you are a copyright owner or authorized representative and believe any material on CampusLoop infringes your copyright, please submit a written notice to **grievance@campusloop.in** or via our [Contact Page](/contact). Valid requests are reviewed and acted upon within **24 to 36 hours**.

---

## 6. Disclaimer of Warranties & Educational Disclaimers

1. **Study Companion Disclaimer**: CampusLoop is an independent educational aid created by students for students. While we strive for extreme academic accuracy, notes and solutions may contain human error. **Materials on CampusLoop are not official university administrative circulars.** Students must always verify exam schedules and syllabus criteria with their respective university departments.
2. **"As-Is" Provision**: The Service is provided on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including merchantability or fitness for a particular academic outcome.
3. **No Guarantee of Grades**: CampusLoop does not guarantee specific exam marks, SGPA scores, or university placement offers.

---

## 7. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable Indian law, CampusLoop, its founders, and contributors shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of your access to or inability to use the Platform, including loss of data or academic standing.

---

## 8. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the **laws of the Republic of India**.
- Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent **courts situated in Vadodara, Gujarat, India**.

---

## 9. Contact & Support

For questions regarding these Terms:

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.description: Comprehensive refund, return, and cancellation policy in compliance with India's Consumer Protection Act 2019 and E-Commerce Rules 2020.
refund.body:
*Effective Date: 14 November 2026 | Last Updated: 14 November 2026*

This Refund and Cancellation Policy outlines the terms governing digital access, voluntary contributions, and ancillary services on **CampusLoop**, operated by **Maher Bhatt** in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. This policy is formulated in compliance with the **Consumer Protection Act, 2019**, the **Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020**, and the **Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023**.

---

## 1. 100% Free Core Educational Services

- **Zero Cost for Core Academic Tools**: Access to CampusLoop's digital Library, syllabus notes, unit guides, exam question banks, SGPA & attendance calculators, and practical coding labs is **100% free of charge**.
- **No Recurring Subscriptions**: We do not charge recurring monthly or annual platform access fees.
- **No Hidden Charges**: There are no hidden processing fees, checkout add-ons, or surprise deductions.

---

## 2. Ancillary Paid Services (Workshops, Physical Kits & Events)

From time to time, CampusLoop may organize optional physical workshops, technical bootcamps, campus hackathons, or physical study kits (e.g., printed spiral-bound question banks). The following terms apply to any paid ancillary offerings:

### A. Cancellation Guidelines
1. **Workshops & Bootcamps**: You may cancel your registration up to **24 hours prior** to the scheduled start time of the session by emailing [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in) with your Registration ID.
2. **Physical Study Kits**: You may cancel your order at any time **before the kit has been dispatched** for shipping.

### B. Refund Timelines & Mode of Payment
- **Eligibility**: When a cancellation request meets the criteria above, a **100% refund** will be initiated.
- **Processing Timeline**: Refunds are processed within **5 to 7 business days** from the date the cancellation is approved.
- **Original Payment Source**: In accordance with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines, refunds are credited directly back to the original payment source (UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking).
- **Deductions**: No hidden cancellation penalties or platform surcharges are deducted from approved refunds.

---

## 3. Voluntary Student Contributions & Tips

Any voluntary student contributions, donations, or "buy me a coffee" tips made to support server hosting and content transcription are voluntary and non-refundable once processed. However, if a duplicate contribution was deducted due to a payment gateway timeout or technical failure, we will issue a full reversal upon verification within 3 to 5 business days.

---

## 4. Dispute Resolution & Consumer Grievance

If you have any questions or require assistance with a refund, please contact our dedicated support desk:
- **Customer Care Email**: [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in)
- **Grievance Officer**: Maher Bhatt ([grievance@campusloop.in](mailto:grievance@campusloop.in))

cookies.title: Cookie & Storage Policy
cookies.description: Transparent disclosure of cookies and browser local storage used on CampusLoop. Strictly necessary storage with zero tracking or advertising cookies.
cookies.body:
*Effective Date: 14 November 2026 | Last Updated: 14 November 2026*

This Cookie & Storage Policy explains how **CampusLoop** uses cookies, local browser storage (`localStorage`), and related web technologies. We are committed to complete transparency regarding the data saved on your device.

---

## 1. Our Privacy-First Commitment

- **No Advertising Cookies**: CampusLoop does **not** host third-party advertising cookies, marketing tracking pixels, or cross-site tracking scripts.
- **No Data Selling**: We do not sell or monetize your browsing history or reading behavior.
- **Strictly Necessary Operations**: Over 95% of the data saved on your browser is stored locally via HTML5 `localStorage` to ensure the platform functions seamlessly, loads instantly on mobile networks, and remembers your study progress offline.

---

## 2. Complete Inventory of Browser Storage Items

Below is an itemized breakdown of every local storage key utilized by CampusLoop:

| Storage Key | Category | Purpose | Expiration / Lifespan |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `theme` / `vite-ui-theme` | Strictly Necessary | Remembers your preference between Light Mode and Dark Mode | Persistent (until cleared) |
| `campusloop_cookie_consent` | Strictly Necessary | Records your preference regarding cookie consent ("accepted" or "essential") | 1 Year |
| `itm_student_profile` | Functional / Performance | Caches your student profile (university, branch, semester) so your dashboard renders instantly without waiting for network round-trips | Persistent (refreshed on login) |
| `campusloop_onboarding_done` | Functional | Tracks whether you have completed the student onboarding wizard to prevent showing it redundantly | Persistent |
| `sb-*-auth-token` | Strictly Necessary | Secure authentication session token generated by Supabase (PKCE flow) to keep you safely logged in | Session / Refreshable |
| `cl_reading_progress_v1` | Functional | Saves your scroll position in syllabus documents so you never lose your place while reading | Persistent |
| `cl_reader_notes_v1` | Functional | Saves personal in-line study notes you write while reading study guides | Persistent (never leaves your device) |
| `itm_daily_attendance_log` | Functional | Stores your custom subject attendance logs for the 75% criteria calculator | Persistent (stored locally) |
| `itm_bookmarks` | Functional | Stores your bookmarked study units and question bank formulas | Persistent |

---

## 3. Cookie Consent Banner & Controls

When you first visit CampusLoop, a non-intrusive Cookie Consent Banner is displayed giving you clear, unbundled options:
1. **Accept All**: Enables both strictly necessary and functional caching for maximum speed and reading persistence.
2. **Essential Only**: Restricts storage strictly to security tokens and theme preferences.
3. **Learn More**: Directs you to this comprehensive policy.

---

## 4. How to Manage or Clear Your Storage

You can clear or inspect all stored data at any time:
1. **In CampusLoop**: Visit your [Profile Settings](/profile) -> click "Export / Delete Data" to clear all cached study data from your device.
2. **In Your Browser**: Go to your browser Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Clear Browsing Data -> select "Cookies and Site Data" for `itm-notes-new.vercel.app`.

---

## 5. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our use of storage or cookies, please reach out to:
- **Email**: [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in)
- **Grievance Desk**: [grievance@campusloop.in](mailto:grievance@campusloop.in)
- **Contact Page**: [CampusLoop Contact](/contact)

data-deletion.title: Data Deletion & Portability
data-deletion.description: How to export or permanently delete your personal data on CampusLoop in accordance with Section 12 of the DPDP Act 2023.
data-deletion.body:
*Effective Date: 14 November 2026 | Last Updated: 14 November 2026*

Under **Section 12 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)**, every Data Principal has the statutory right to request the correction, completion, updating, and **permanent erasure** of their personal data. CampusLoop provides complete self-service tools and an auditable deletion procedure.

---

## 1. What Data Can Be Deleted?

When you request data deletion, the following items are permanently erased from our live databases:
- **Authentication Account**: Your login record, email address, and OAuth authentication tokens.
- **Student Profile**: Your full name, profile picture, university, branch, semester, section, and enrollment number.
- **Academic & Social Data**: Your saved bookmarks, daily study streaks, attendance logs, flashcards, quiz attempts, forum posts, comments, and direct messages.
- **Support Inquiries**: Historical contact tickets and inquiries associated with your user ID.

---

## 2. Option A: Instant In-App Data Export & Deletion (Recommended)

You can initiate an instant export or deletion directly within the application in less than 60 seconds:

1. Sign in to your account and navigate to [My Profile](/profile).
2. Scroll down to the **Data Privacy & Account** section.
3. Click **Export / Delete Data**.
4. **To Export**: Click "Download Data Backup" to immediately download a complete, readable JSON file containing all your notes, reading progress, and attendance logs.
5. **To Delete**: In the red Account Removal box, type `DELETE` into the confirmation field and click **Request Account Removal**.
6. Your local browser storage will be purged immediately, your active session will be terminated, and an automated deletion ticket will be logged for permanent database cleanup.

---

## 3. Option B: Direct Deletion Request via Email

If you are unable to log in to your account or prefer submitting a manual request:

- Send an email to our Grievance Officer at [grievance@campusloop.in](mailto:grievance@campusloop.in) (or [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in)).
- **Subject**: `Data Deletion Request - [Your Registered Email]`.
- **Body**: State clearly that you request the total erasure of your CampusLoop account and all associated personal data.

### Verification & Erasure Timeline
- **Acknowledgment**: Within **48 hours** of receiving your email.
- **Erasure Execution**: We will verify ownership of the email and permanently erase your account data within **30 calendar days**.
- **Confirmation**: A written confirmation will be delivered to your email address once the deletion process is complete.

---

## 4. Statutory Contact Details

- **Data Protection & Grievance Officer**: Maher Bhatt
- **Physical Address**: CampusLoop, Near ITM SLS Baroda University Campus, Paldi, Vadodara, Gujarat 391510, India
- **Email**: [grievance@campusloop.in](mailto:grievance@campusloop.in)
- **Support Desk**: [Contact Us](/contact)

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.description: Rules for maintaining a respectful, collaborative, and academically honest environment on CampusLoop.
guidelines.body:
CampusLoop's community is built by students, for students, to facilitate peer learning, mutual academic support, and shared study materials. These Guidelines apply across all public feeds, comments, study group messages, and user profiles.

## 1. Respect & Collegiality

- **Be Respectful**: Treat fellow students, faculty, and contributors with courtesy. Constructive debate is encouraged; personal abuse, harassment, discrimination, or hate speech will result in immediate bans.
- **Helpful Contributions**: Share useful explanations, working code snippets, diagrams, and verified textbook references.
- **Credit Original Authors**: When sharing handwritten notes, practical files, or presentation summaries, provide proper credit to original creators or professors.

## 2. Academic Integrity

- **No Live Exam Collusion**: Strictly prohibited is posting questions, answers, or seeking assistance during active, scheduled mid-semester tests (MSTs), final university examinations, or proctored assessments.
- **No Malicious Scripts**: Do not post exploit scripts, destructive virus code, or unauthorized scraping bots in the Coding Lab or forums.
- **No Impersonation**: Do not impersonate university faculty, examination controllers, or fellow students.

## 3. Reporting & Content Moderation

- **Report Button**: Use the report option available on any post or comment to flag inappropriate material.
- **Moderation Action**: Our moderation team reviews reports within 24 hours and takes corrective actions, including content removal, temporary warning suspensions, or permanent account bans.
- **Direct Contact**: You may also report violations directly via our [Contact Page](/contact) or by emailing [support@campusloop.in](mailto:support@campusloop.in).
